About TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC

TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC provides behavioral health services for adults, with a focus on daily living skills, structured care, and greater stability. Based in Danville, we bring together clinical, operational, and direct support personnel.

Support

A compassionate approach that starts with listening and respect.

Stabilize

A commitment to structure, consistency, and a supportive environment.

Empower

A focus on practical skills and the foundations for greater independence.

The people behind TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC

Experience in leadership, behavioral health,
and community support.

Justin WilliamsCEO / Director+

Justin brings more than 17 years of leadership, operational management, and organizational oversight from his career in the U.S. military and Department of Defense civilian sectors.

Currently pursuing a doctoral degree in Business Administration, he combines his PMP and CISM credentials with a patient-centered approach to healthcare administration. His priorities include operational excellence, compliance, and resource planning for structured, compassionate mental health care.

Edward “Greg” BuchananDeputy Director & Founder+

Greg brings more than a decade of partnership with Danville-Pittsylvania Community Services (DPCS), providing supportive housing for individuals managing mental illness and substance use challenges.

His experience includes specialized supportive housing, crisis management, conflict resolution, and de-escalation. Through TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC and his work alongside MHCB/PHP, he focuses on safe, stable environments and the practical foundations that support recovery.

Chandra BrandronOperations Manager & Compliance Officer+

Chandra brings more than 20 years of experience in mental health and substance use services to program operations and compliance.

Her work brings together daily operations, client safety, regulatory oversight, internal audit protocols, and staff training. She focuses on client safety, organizational integrity, and a structured environment that supports individuals, families, and the staff who serve them.

Your questions

What is MHCB?+

Mental Health Center-Based builds daily living skills and stability to support independence. It offers daily skill training for adults 18+ with serious mental illness.

What is PHP?+

The Partial Hospitalization Program provides intensive daily day treatment for adults without overnight stays.

Who does TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC serve?+

TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC’s programs serve adults in the Danville region. MHCB is for adults 18+ with serious mental illness. Contact TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC to discuss the screening and assessment process.

How do I start services?+

Contact TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC, complete an initial screening and clinical assessment, and review coverage with the team. These steps guide appropriate next steps toward care.

Does a request guarantee admission?+

No. Submitting does not guarantee admission or care.

How is insurance handled?+

Coverage is reviewed during the intake process. A payer list is not being published on this review site.

What are your hours and location?+

Office hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. TTP Solutions Healthcare LLC is at 3304 US Highway 29 BUS, Danville, VA 24540. Please call for visit arrangements; specific walk-in procedures are awaiting owner confirmation.

Which communities do you serve?+

Danville, Chatham, and South Boston in Virginia; Pelham, Yanceyville, and Eden in North Carolina; and all surrounding areas.

What should I do during a crisis?+

If you are experiencing a crisis or emergency, call 911 or call/text 988 immediately. Do not wait for a website response.
